depth_justification: The copilot is stuck in a degenerate loop, repeating the same clinical-validation question ([P2.D3]) almost verbatim for nine turns and never engaging with the developer's specific disclosures (consent-by-proxy for incapacitated patients, single unvalidated CH-German variant, incomplete MDR CE marking, light-touch UCD). The final report does name MindBoost-specific facts (N=80 RCT, CH-German vs AT/DE idioms, MDR vigilance) but pastes the user's own words as 'Severity' lines with wrong/invented HERA IDs and no actual severity rating, so the specificity is borrowed rather than analyzed.
actionability_justification: Most turns deliver zero actionable content because they repeat one boilerplate paragraph; the closing report offers a few concrete-sounding steps (report effect sizes/CIs, run structured iterative UCD rounds, formalize continuous vigilance under MDR Rule 11) but they are misattributed, repeated, and bolted onto irrelevant regulations (e.g. 'GDPR Art. 8, ISO 82304-2' attached to language localization and accessibility without explanation), so a developer could not reliably implement them tomorrow.
salient_examples: So the most important question is: [P2.D3] — Is the game-based exercise content of MindBoost clinically validated and, if so, by what evidence? ... Let me ask it now: [P2.D3]. (repeated nearly verbatim across ~7 consecutive turns, ignoring every new user answer)
